items.description: Vulnerability in the Oracle AutoVue product of Oracle Supply Chain (component: Security).   The supported version that is affected is 21.1.0. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with logon to the infrastructure where Oracle AutoVue executes to compromise Oracle AutoVue.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of Oracle AutoVue accessible data and unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS) of Oracle AutoVue. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.0 (Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:L).

Vulnerability in the Oracle AutoVue product of Oracle Supply Chain (component: Security).   The supported version that is affected is 21.1.0. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle AutoVue.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle AutoVue. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.1 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle AutoVue.
